description: This file implements the JSON-RPC controller interface for plugin management within the WPEFramework. It includes methods for activating, deactivating, hibernating, and cloning plugins, as well as retrieving system and plugin status, managing configurations, and handling network discovery.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main class implementing the JSON-RPC interface for plugin control and system information within WPEFramework.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all JSON-RPC methods and properties for plugin control.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all JSON-RPC methods and properties.

methods.name: endpoint_hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates a plugin given its callsign, timeout, and process sequence.

methods.name: endpoint_activate
methods.description: Activates a plugin specified by its callsign.

methods.name: endpoint_deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin specified by its callsign.

methods.name: endpoint_unavailable
methods.description: Marks a plugin as unavailable.

methods.name: endpoint_startdiscovery
methods.description: Starts network discovery with a specified TTL.

methods.name: endpoint_storeconfig
methods.description: Stores the current configuration.

methods.name: endpoint_delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified path from persistent storage.

methods.name: endpoint_harakiri
methods.description: Reboots the device.

methods.name: endpoint_clone
methods.description: Clones a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about plugins, either all or a specific one.

methods.name: get_links
methods.description: Retrieves information about active connections.

methods.name: get_processinfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the framework process.

methods.name: get_subsystems
methods.description: Retrieves status of subsystems.

methods.name: get_discoveryresults
methods.description: Retrieves SSDP network discovery results.

methods.name: get_environment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: get_configuration
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a service.

methods.name: set_configuration
methods.description: Updates the configuration of a service.

methods.name: event_statechange
methods.description: Signals a plugin state change event.
